title: Genie Code scheduled tasks are now generally available
body: Genie Code scheduled tasks are now generally available. You can schedule Genie Code to run a prompt on a recurring schedule. Each run executes your prompt as a full Genie Code session and produces a continuable Genie chat with the results, so you can turn recurring analysis and other work into an unattended background task. Create a scheduled task by asking Genie Code in chat or from the Schedules menu. See [Genie Code scheduled tasks](/aws/en/genie-code/scheduled-tasks).
